versions.description: AFK Kick — periodically checks player positions and warns/kicks idle players. A permission exempts specific players from AFK detection.
versions.configSchema: {"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object","properties":{"checksBeforeWarning":{"type":"number","default":3,"minimum":1,"description":"Number of idle checks before sending a warning PM to the player"},"checksBeforeKick":{"type":"number","default":5,"minimum":2,"description":"Number of idle checks before kicking the player"},"warningMessage":{"type":"string","default":"You will be kicked for being AFK!","description":"Private message sent to the player when they reach the warning threshold"},"kickMessage":{"type":"string","default":"Kicked for being AFK","description":"Kick reason shown to the player when they are kicked for being AFK"},"positionThreshold":{"type":"number","default":5,"minimum":1,"description":"Distance in blocks a player must move to be considered active (resets idle count)"}},"required":[],"additionalProperties":false}

cronJobs.name: check-afk
cronJobs.description: Check online players for AFK and warn/kick based on configured thresholds

functions.name: afk-helpers

permissions.description: Exempts a player from AFK detection and kick entirely
